<!doctype html><html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>家庭AI创作课</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;background:#f4efe9;color:#2f2825}button,input,textarea{font:inherit}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.app{max-width:980px;margin:auto;min-height:100vh}.top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:12px 18px;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #eadfd8}.logo{font-weight:900}.logo small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#8b7770}.tabs{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:8px;background:#f3ece7;padding:5px;border-radius:999px}.tabs button{border:0;background:transparent;padding:9px 15px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer}.tabs button.on{background:#ed5a55;color:white}.view{display:none}.view.on{display:block}section{margin:14px;background:white;border-radius:22px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #72503512}.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.15fr;align-items:center;min-height:360px;overflow:hidden}.hero h1{font-size:54px;line-height:1.02;margin:10px 0}.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:#e94f49}.hero p{color:#74645d;line-height:1.7}.hero img{width:100%;height:310px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:auto}.badges{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.badges span{padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #eaded8;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px}.cta{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}.btn{border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 18px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer}.primary{background:#e9514d;color:white}.secondary{background:white;border:1px solid #e3d4cc}h2{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:28px}.lead{margin:0 0 18px;color:#7c6a63}.projects{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;align-items:center}.projects img,.challenge img{width:100%;height:290px;object-fit:contain}.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.card{padding:14px;border-radius:16px;background:#fff2ef;border:1px solid #f0d9d3;cursor:pointer}.card:nth-child(2){background:#fff7df}.card:nth-child(3){background:#eef7e9}.card:nth-child(4){background:#edf5fa}.card b{display:block;font-size:16px}.card small{color:#78675f}.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:8px}.step{text-align:center;padding:10px 6px;background:#fff7f4;border-radius:14px}.step i{display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;height:36px;margin:auto;border-radius:50%;background:#e85853;color:#fff;font-style:normal;font-weight:900}.step b{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:12px}.prompt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}label{font-size:12px;font-weight:800}input,textarea{width:100%;margin-top:5px;padding:10px;border:1px solid #ddd0c8;border-radius:10px}textarea{height:84px;resize:vertical}pre{margin:0;background:#222;color:#eee;border-radius:14px;padding:15px;min-height:250px;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12px}.challenge{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:center}.foot{padding:18px;text-align:center;color:#7d6d66;font-size:12px}
.kid{background:#3e2a18;color:#24180f}.kid .top{background:#362417;color:#fff;border-color:#21150d}.kid .tabs{background:#5d3d22}.kid .tabs button.on{background:#4c9b35}.kid section{border-radius:8px;border:4px solid #2a1a0f;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #8a633b,6px 6px #21150d;background:#ede0c3}.kid .hero{background:linear-gradient(#76c9f7 0 65%,#6cae3b 65% 78%,#75502b 78%)}.kid .hero h1{font-family:Impact,"Arial Black",sans-serif;color:white;text-shadow:4px 4px #222;-webkit-text-stroke:1px #111}.kid .hero h1 em{color:#ffd12f;-webkit-text-stroke:1px #4a2b08}.kid .badges span{background:#4b8f31;color:#fff;border:3px solid #234e1b;border-radius:5px}.kid .primary{background:#50ad31;border:3px solid #225b18;border-radius:5px;box-shadow:4px 4px #21150d}.kid .secondary{border:3px solid #704b29;border-radius:5px;background:#f1dfb7}.kid .card{border-radius:5px;border:3px solid #74502e;background:#d9c8a6}.kid .step{border-radius:4px;border:3px solid #77664d;background:#d7d1c5}.kid .step i{border-radius:3px;background:#3d9832}.kid pre{border:4px solid #111;border-radius:4px}.kid input,.kid textarea{border-radius:4px;border:2px solid #8a7357}@media(max-width:720px){.hero,.projects,.prompt,.challenge{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero h1{font-size:40px}.hero img{height:250px}.steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}section{margin:8px;padding:16px}}
</style></head><body><div id="app" class="app"><header class="top"><div class="logo">家庭AI创作课<small>用 ChatGPT 把想法做成网页</small></div><div class="tabs"><button data-mode="mom">妈妈版</button><button data-mode="kid">儿子版</button></div></header>
<div class="view" data-view="mom"><section class="hero"><div><span>妈妈版 · 温暖剪贴画风</span><h1>把想法<br><em>做成真的</em></h1><p>先让 ChatGPT 画出完整设计图和独立透明素材，再让它按图写网页、上传 GitHub、部署 Vercel。</p><div class="badges"><span>零基础</span><span>先出图</span><span>真实可用</span></div><div class="cta"><button class="btn primary" data-go="prompt">生成提示词</button><button class="btn secondary" data-switch="kid">看看儿子版</button></div></div><img src="data:image/webp;base64,
